data.why: The app ships its own example catalog (loaded automatically into localStorage on first run and downloadable via 'Load example rows'); the repo's CSVs plus a hand-written edge-case CSV (missing marker/fluor, expired vial, low stock, out-of-stock, an unmapped fluor) let the agent exercise Import CSV and its validation paths.

goals: design a flow panel for a set of surface markers and see them auto-assigned to fluor channels without spectral conflicts
flag a panel that needs more channels than the instrument has and add the extra panel the app suggests
mark backbone markers (e.g. CD45, CD3) so they land in the same fluor on every panel
import the lab's own antibody catalog from a CSV and have the solver respect which vials are in stock, low or expired
export a printable panel figure and a per-detector CSV for the lab notebook

review.summary: This tree captures what the panel designer is for: inventory, then solver-assisted panel design with backbone, PI and overflow handling, then notebook export. Its phases, tasks and features are well cut and mostly backed by the screens. It needs small fixes before filing: the Import CSV replace-vs-append claim is wrong, two pieces of evidence don't show what they're cited for (Print figure, catalog downloads), two branch tags are wrong, and Google Sheet sync needs a not-reached task node.
